verdict.rationale: Attio's docs say its data model lets you define custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types, beyond the default people/companies and optional deal objects. Marketing pages add customizable fields and linking objects via a graph model, and the App SDK GraphQL API can query custom records. Missing for 10: relationship/record-reference attributes documented only at marketing level, no evidence of creating objects or attributes programmatically via the API, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
